scientific.integrity: The primary article was inspected at the Caputo Volterra representation, equations (4.3)–(4.7), and the numerical-simulation section. The standard Diethelm–Ford–Freed Adams derivation was inspected at its Volterra-history construction and fractional predictor formula. The bundled checker independently replays the constant-forcing consistency test. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the printed numerical derivation. It does not identify the unavailable implementation with the displayed recurrence, does not claim the plotted curves are necessarily numerically wrong, and does not reassess unrelated analytical theorems in the article.

title: A sign error breaks the printed fractional Adams–Bashforth derivation in a COVID delay model
